name: Alagón (Spain)
description: Red field with the bars of Aragon along the upper edge, charged at the hoist with the crowned arms of Alagón (the bars of Aragon above a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Alagón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe of yellow and red bars along the upper edge
Alagón arms — bars of Aragon above a castle on red
bars and castle of the arms
